m.ctx.prompt:
Write the context of this project so that other coding agents read it before working on it.
Write it in Markdown, in English, at most 25 lines, with these sections: "## What it is", "## Structure", "## How to run and test it", "## Conventions".
Use only what appears below; if something cannot be known, leave it out instead of inventing it. Reply ONLY with the Markdown, with no explanations or code blocks wrapping it. Do not use tools or read files: everything needed is here.
